reviewNotes: Independent group audits and cross-review; UX live sampling by root only.
REL-COR-003 and ENG-REL-01 are one defect; REL-TST items are associated regression work.
D7-03 round selection is mitigation; scientific distractor review remains.
D10-03 is target-contest dependency; 2027 partial themes have official announcements.

findings.title: A stale open tab silently replaces newer learning progress

evidence.observation: Replica selection occurs only in init; no later cross-tab synchronization or stale-write check exists.
Each action replaces the shared localStorage value with its complete in-memory state; line 149 does the same for IndexedDB current.

evidence.method: Read-only tsx harness using two initialized real GameStore instances and a shared localStorage fake

findings.scenario: Two tabs load before either learns. A observes and reads cyanobacteria; stale B observes stromatolites and overwrites A's records and points. Reload restores only B's snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Coordinate a single active writer or compare/reconcile the authoritative revision before mutations. A stale tab must reload or explicitly take over before replacing newer data. Preserve the economy validator and do not sum independently stored balances.
findings.validation: Add a shared-storage two-live-store regression and a two-page same-context browser check. Interleave observations, reads, settings, and reset; verify no silent removal/resurrection of learning and no repeated awards. Focused harness reproduced the current defect; no browser was run.

findings.title: A delayed settings import commits after a newer import or reset

evidence.observation: After awaiting file.text(), the handler unconditionally imports and navigates without a request generation or dialog/lifecycle check.
The separate peer importer already rejects obsolete requests and disconnected hosts, providing a local implementation pattern.

evidence.method: Actual settings-import callback extracted via TypeScript AST and executed with deferred reads and real GameStore

findings.scenario: Choose A, then B, and let B finish first. A later replaces the accepted B save. A pending read also replaces a reset save after its settings dialog has closed.
findings.recommendation: Use an import request token, invalidate it on close/reset, and check both currency and dialog connectivity after the read and before commit. Coordinate competing replacement actions while committing.
findings.validation: Defer two File.text calls and resolve in reverse order; only the latest active request may write. Close/reset before resolution and assert the resulting save stays byte-for-byte unchanged and stale navigation does not occur. The actual callback was reproduced without a browser.

findings.title: A worker update discards previously prepared offline models

evidence.observation: Installation excludes model/decoder resources, then requests skipWaiting at line 20.
Activation deletes every prior scoped cache, including the user's fully prepared revision.
Any packaged-file change can change the cache revision.

evidence.method: Actual worker script install/activate/fetch handlers in node:vm with seeded old revision and disabled fake network

findings.scenario: Prepare the full offline exhibit, visit after a new revision is published, then disconnect. New revision activation removes the prepared models/decoders. Old open clients can also lose a changed-name lazy chunk.
findings.recommendation: Preserve full-offline opt-in and complete required new resources before retiring a prepared cache. Coordinate activation/reload with existing clients. Keep scope isolation and do not blindly copy changed assets solely by unversioned URL.
findings.validation: Add a two-revision cache transition test with prepared A and changed B, then offline model/decoder and changed lazy-chunk requests. Handler-level missing-cache behavior is reproduced; actual browser upgrade confirmation remains for the coordinator.

findings.title: An accepted maximum timestamp breaks atomic import and later actions

evidence.observation: Any finite parsed date is retained, including the maximum representable date.
Incrementing that saved timestamp by one and calling toISOString throws RangeError.
Import replaces this.state before the failing revision calculation, violating the expected atomic rejection.

evidence.method: Read-only tsx harness using real validator/importer

findings.scenario: Import an otherwise-valid damaged/edited save with the maximum timestamp. It reports failure after replacing current memory, and subsequent learning mutations continue to throw. A stored such record loads but then cannot save.
findings.recommendation: Validate or normalize timestamps into an advanceable range and allocate a valid next revision before assigning imported state. Preserve normal legacy timestamp compatibility and startup reconciliation semantics.
findings.validation: Test maximum, maximum-minus-one, invalid, and large-future timestamps. Rejected imports must preserve the prior export and perform no writes; later ordinary actions must work. Stored extremes must use recovery/rejection or safe normalization. Current failure was reproduced against real GameStore.

findings.title: Save recovery coverage omits two simultaneous writers

evidence.observation: Safe-save cases cover sequential replica reload/recovery but do not interleave mutations from two initialized live stores.
Real IndexedDB fallback coverage uses a single page. Existing e2e files do not create a second same-context page for a stale-writer scenario.

findings.scenario: A fully passing sequential recovery suite misses the demonstrated silent overwrite in REL-COR-001.
findings.recommendation: Add one deterministic shared-storage regression and one same-context two-page regression, including reset ownership and economy invariants.
findings.validation: The new test should fail on this baseline's stale write and pass only when a stale tab cannot silently replace newer learning or resurrect reset progress. No full suite was rerun in this subtask.

resolution.note: Included in related save/import/offline fixes, not counted as another product defect.

findings.title: Progress import tests omit delayed reads and revision boundaries

evidence.observation: UI test covers reset cancellation and an oversized file, not an in-flight read crossing close/reset/reselection.
Valid/invalid legacy imports are performed in normal completion order.
The atomic inconsistent-import cases do not cover revision allocator overflow.

findings.scenario: REL-COR-002 and REL-COR-004 pass outside the present import tests despite breaking save replacement semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add controlled deferred File.text lifecycle tests and exact revision-boundary atomic-import tests. Assert the persisted save and navigation behavior, not only toast text.
findings.validation: Resolve file reads in reverse order and after close/reset; verify no obsolete commit/navigation. Reject an overflow timestamp with byte-for-byte state preservation and no write. Both current source failures were reproduced read-only.

resolution.note: Included in related save/import/offline fixes, not counted as another product defect.

findings.title: Offline tests omit cache upgrade and retirement transitions

evidence.observation: Unit tests cover page-side readiness/message failures, not actual public/sw.js install/activate behavior.
Offline browser case prepares and reloads the same revision.
Annotation offline coverage likewise remains within one prepared revision.

findings.scenario: The suite verifies a freshly prepared cache yet misses REL-COR-003 when a second revision replaces it.
findings.recommendation: Load the actual worker script into a small in-memory CacheStorage harness and add a two-version production-browser check owned by the coordinator.
findings.validation: Prepare A, activate changed B, disconnect, then assert model/decoder availability, correct scoped retirement, and either retained A lazy chunks or a coordinated fully prepared reload. Actual handler-level loss is already reproduced.

resolution.note: Included in related save/import/offline fixes, not counted as another product defect.

findings.title: Clarify that restarting retains raw recovery copies

evidence.observation: Reset UI says it clears this browser's learning records.
Invalid raw local records are archived under recovery keys; line 143 does the same in IndexedDB.
Reset replaces the active snapshot but does not delete or expose recovery records.

evidence.method: Real GameStore with invalid original local save, recovery-triggering action, and reset

findings.scenario: A user selects clear/restart on a shared device expecting learning records to be removed, while previous raw recovery copies remain in the origin's storage.
findings.recommendation: Make retention explicit in restart wording. If actual local-data erasure is required, expose a separate reviewed/confirmed action covering this application's current/recovery records in both stores. Do not silently delete existing recovery history.
findings.validation: Seed both stores' recovery entries and test the documented restart retention policy. If an explicit erase action is added, verify it removes only the authorized application data. This is a privacy/control proposal; no exfiltration or exploitable XSS was established.

findings.title: Lab navigation retains every delegated input listener and comparison subtree
evidence: src/modes/lab-view.ts:31–33 adds an anonymous listener to the persistent container; line 42 does not remove it
src/main.ts:76,84–90 reuses #main-content between modes
findings.scenario: Visit lab, run a comparison, leave for codex, and repeat. Each drought/predation input on later visits invokes all retained old callbacks and keeps each old detached comparison/state alive.
findings.recommendation: Name the delegated input handler and remove it in mountLab's returned cleanup, or bind it to a mount-scoped AbortController that cleanup aborts.
findings.validation: Mount/unmount lab repeatedly on the same container; assert the input listener count returns to baseline after each cleanup and only the active comparison refreshes once per slider input. Root should check repeated navigation in the browser.

findings.title: Releasing GLTF textures never closes loader-created ImageBitmaps
evidence: src/scene/resource-lifetime.ts:22 and 34–37 retain textures then call only resource.dispose()
Installed GLTFLoader.js:80–82,2594–2600,3325–3332 selects ImageBitmapLoader and constructs Texture(imageBitmap)
Installed Texture.js:636 only emits a dispose event; current reconstruction GLBs contain 15 embedded images
findings.scenario: On a browser with ImageBitmap support, repeatedly enter chapters containing textured external reconstructions, switch chapters, or dispose while loads finish. GPU textures are disposed but image bitmap resources receive no explicit close.
findings.recommendation: Add final-owner disposal of the shared underlying bitmap/image source, separately from individual texture references. Avoid closing a bitmap while another retained texture still shares it.
findings.validation: Use two retained texture wrappers sharing one close-spied image bitmap: first release must not close, final release must close exactly once; repeated release stays idempotent. Include a late stale GLTF callback. Measure browser memory separately before claiming a byte saving.

findings.title: Whole-transfer offline timeout expires during healthy slow downloads
evidence: src/main.ts:206 supplies a fixed 45000ms cache timeout
src/core/offline.ts:28–37 reports progress but never extends that deadline and line 38 closes its message ports
Direct current-asset measurement: 13 GLBs, 11989972 raw bytes, 7519346 gzip-level-6 bytes; 60.15 seconds for GLBs alone at an assumed 1 Mb/s
findings.scenario: Prepare the complete offline gallery for the first time on a steady 1 Mb/s connection with valid periodic progress. The operation reports timeout at 45s even though the worker is still successfully downloading resources.
findings.recommendation: Use a progress-reset inactivity timeout with a generous explicit absolute maximum, preserving stalled-worker failure handling and accurate progress.
findings.validation: A fake-channel test must deliver valid increasing progress over more than 45 seconds and still succeed; a stopped-progress test must time out and clean up ports. Root can validate with a throttled production browser run.

findings.title: Dimetrodon's eight-influence skin is not compatible with the four-influence renderer
evidence: public/models/dimetrodon.glb mesh 0 primitive 0: JOINTS_1 accessor 365 and WEIGHTS_1 accessor 367
Direct binary measurement: 505/9955 vertices have nonzero secondary weights, max ignored mass 0.05992674455, mean 0.00036428008 across all vertices
Installed GLTFLoader.js:2217–2228 maps only JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0; skinning_vertex.glsl.js:7–10 uses only four influences
scripts/validate-models.ts:51–77 does not check this compatibility
findings.scenario: Load animated Dimetrodon in a chapter scene or model-viewer. Nonzero extra source influences are ignored and the first four are normalized. The mismatch is verified; visible severity has not been measured.
findings.recommendation: Add a maximum-supported-influences compatibility check, explicitly reduce the asset to strongest four weights and normalize only after reviewing sampled animations, and preserve source/attribution metadata. Secondary attributes contain 199100 logical bytes before rewritten encoding.
findings.validation: Assert no nonzero unsupported influence sets remain, sample both animations at multiple times for finite stable bounds and acceptable visible deformation, and rerun model/manifest validation after any asset change. Do not claim anatomical improvement from the numeric check alone.

resolution.remaining: Eight/four influence difference is measured; visible animation impact and acceptable conversion are unverified. Source asset preserved.

findings.title: Service-worker activation deletes code still referenced by open older pages
evidence: public/sw.js:20 forces immediate activation; lines 23–24 delete previous cache and claim existing clients
src/modes/specimen.ts:77 defers the hashed model-viewer import
Current-source VM reproduction: after activation only life-museum-/life/-new remains; an existing-page request for the previously cached old lazy module returns 404
findings.scenario: Keep release A open without opening a specimen; deploy B and trigger a worker update from another visit/tab. After B activates, open the first specimen in A. A requests its old hashed lazy chunk after the server and cache have moved to B, so the original model component fails to load.
findings.recommendation: Use the default waiting lifecycle; preserve the old cache until no old controlled clients remain. If retaining full offline preparation on update, populate the new revision cache from freshly fetched new model/decoder responses and keep A intact on any install failure.
findings.validation: Two-release production test: open A, install B while A stays open, assert B waiting and old chunk/model works offline; close all A clients, assert B activates with B bytes and only same-scope A cache is removed. Also test failed B model refresh, partial versus complete offline state, and unrelated app caches.

findings.title: An opportunistic cache write failure rejects a successful online asset request
evidence: public/sw.js:35 fetches a successful network response, line 36 awaits cache.put before line 37 returns it
Current-source VM reproduction: fetch returned HTTP 200, cache.put rejected QuotaExceededError, and the service-worker response promise rejected
findings.scenario: The gallery is online but cache quota or storage availability prevents caching a newly downloaded model or code chunk. The user gets a model/component load failure despite receiving a valid network response.
findings.recommendation: Catch only the best-effort fetch-path cache write failure and still return the original successful response. Keep explicit CACHE_ALL errors visible to the offline-preparation operation.
findings.validation: Execute the SW fetch handler with network 200 and a rejecting cache.put; assert the original response is returned. Also check network failures still propagate and CACHE_ALL still returns ok:false on storage failure.

findings.title: Release packaging ties browser verification to file time rather than tested build identity
evidence: scripts/package-competition.ts:9–10 validates build content digest but lines 11–15 check only browser pass/suite data and startTime >= builtAt
scripts/verify-build.ts:13 derives builtAt from dist/index.html filesystem mtime
The browser report contains no releaseContentSha256 binding to the output it exercised
findings.scenario: Keep or restore production build A with an older index timestamp; supply a later complete passing browser report for a different build B; recompute A's build verification. Packaging can accept B's report as evidence for untested A bytes.
findings.recommendation: Record the digest of production files actually served by the full browser run in its report metadata and require equality with the packaged release digest.
findings.validation: A fixture with a fresh passing full-suite report for B and a valid A build digest must be rejected; equal-digest rebuilds should pass independently of incidental filesystem times.

findings.title: 不确定选项被当作证据支持或反对的命题

evidence.detail: 三主题均提供暂时不确定选项（另见29、42）。
四类标签始终相对于我的判断。
直接显示所选不确定原句作为归类参照；入口34行另写只找支持证据。

findings.scenario: 学习者选不确定后，必须判断材料支持或反对该不确定状态，界面未明确要检验的科学说法。
findings.recommendation: 保留原始选择和存储协议；给不确定分支显示明确待检验说法并使用支持该说法/反对该说法等关系措辞，入口改为检验与修订判断。
findings.validation: 三个主题的不确定路线贯穿归类、图、HTML/JSON导出指向同一命题；答案索引、分类枚举、积分、个人Progress和课堂只读隔离不变。

findings.title: 题目反馈默认把第一来源当成所有字段的核对依据

evidence.detail: 三个学习来源固定置于其他来源前。
Chicago登记只覆盖第2—4正文段的鳍、鳞片、颈部组合，未登记每一道题字段覆盖。

findings.scenario: 提塔利克误区题将手指/腕部完整断言反馈为Chicago依据，窄核对范围未出现。不是认定结论错误。
findings.recommendation: 先改成对应档案及字段，并提供来源和核对范围入口；未做人审字段映射时不默认单独引首项机构来源。
findings.validation: 检查三重点档案及仅有C级来源题，反馈精确到字段且范围可达；保持原ID、正确答案、奖励。

findings.title: 重复干扰项允许用唯一新选项解出后两题

evidence.detail: 每个档案3字段题共用同一3个错误选项，仅插入不同正确原文。
默认按原生成顺序呈现未答题。

evidence: 只读独立计算48档案144题：全部96道第二/第三题只有正确答案是新选项；首个最长选项策略答对124/144。
findings.scenario: 完成同档案第一题后，不比较科学含义也能凭选项是否见过答对后两题。
findings.recommendation: 完整修复须逐字段重审平行干扰项；本轮可仅限定一轮每档案一道、跨轮优先未答字段作为缓解。不得以洗牌宣称关闭长度或重复线索；保留题目ID/正确答案/积分契约。
findings.validation: 如仅缓解，确认同轮档案不重复、后续轮覆盖原ID、错题可练及奖励不变；完整内容修复后复算线索并人工确认单一正确答案。

resolution.remaining: Distractor and answer-length clues require item-by-item content review. No psychometric validity claim.

findings.title: 时间排序在解锁更多纪元后仍只有前寒武纪五条

evidence.detail: 排序后取最古老5条，后续年轻档案无法入选。

evidence: 只读按公式计算解锁1/2/4/8章：全部为spriggina,dickinsonia,charnia,cyanobacteria,stromatolites。
findings.scenario: 探索到第八章再练时间排序，仍不会比较任何后续纪元条目。
findings.recommendation: 按已解锁纪元分层挑选并包含当前章代表，保持近似年代说明和无积分契约。
findings.validation: 第一章可完成；解锁4/8章时至少有对应章条目；年代正确判定及重复徽章不增点。

findings.title: 评审入口的完整介绍应把当前交付摘要与历史验证快照分开

evidence.detail: 概览写线上仍为旧基线，22行列132项。
包入口先让评审阅读完整PDF。
后续验收已有2026-11-12的cbba61b部署与135项单元历史记录。

findings.scenario: 评审从详细介绍进入，须跨材料才能理解旧状态与当前交付的区别；旧记录本身有标注，不等同伪造。
findings.recommendation: 开头加一小段当前状态/日期/基线及验证入口；旧数据保留为历史快照，更新PDF走现有文档核验流程。本轮新分支未发布不得沿用旧发布成功。
findings.validation: 从包README/PDF首页/简版三个入口都能读到同一当前与历史边界，计数与构建身份有明确日期。

findings.title: 把教育定位先收敛为一个主题的教师审读交付包

evidence.detail: 目标横跨小学高年级与初中，年龄/时长尚待试测。
已有反馈草案，但没有单主题集中任务/产物/来源范围/追问审读单。

findings.scenario: 教师决定是否试用时，需要把三主题、脚本、参考链接和反馈草案重新拼成一份材料。
findings.recommendation: 先给始祖鸟准备一页任务—产物—判断依据—来源范围—推断边界审读单，附学习记录、文字路线；不等待具体赛事，不虚构课标符合或教学效果。
findings.validation: 各动作/导出字段可与现有活动逐项对应；讲解样例明确标注；真实审读记录只能在实际发生后填写。

findings.title: 具体赛事资格与AI工具规则是需真实目标确认的外部依赖

evidence.detail: 尚未指定具体赛事/届次；历史官方入口/1974本次抓取超时，未断言永久失效。
披露使用OpenAI Codex辅助开发。
组委会2026通知在相关数媒类别限定古建主题并列AI工具要求，只作历史规则核对。

findings.scenario: 未来若选择某届某类别，不能仅凭通用AI披露或旧年规则推断可参赛；当前未指定2027规则。
findings.recommendation: 准备通用规则映射表及可访问的2026历史官方入口；真实报名成员待选定目标后确认当届题材/类别/允许AI范围/资格/材料与签署，保留真实贡献和AI披露。
findings.validation: 每项规则登记年份、类别、官方URL、发布日期、核对日期与适用范围；未知项待定，不外推2027资格或主题。

findings.title: 需补真实辅助技术与移动设备试测
findings.evidence: 2026-11-25 集成 Chromium 实测通过手机导航、焦点恢复、预测提示及窄屏溢出检查；未测试实体设备或屏幕阅读器
findings.scenario: 赛事展示或课堂用户使用真实触屏/屏幕阅读器
findings.recommendation: 按具体设备和辅助技术记录任务完成率与阻碍；不要把当前 DOM 抽样称为 WCAG 认证
findings.validation: 现场使用者完成导航、物种阅读、排序、预测、导出，并记录版本/设备/问题

remediation.note: Original kind names, baseline evidence and review decisions are preserved; resolution is appended separately.
remediation.finalReviewNote: All four original final findings addressed. Coordinator accepts the private badge return extension and defers recoverable writer-lock contention in future lock-aware fallbacks; no claim that all residuals are fixed.

residualFindings.issue: A lock-aware retained release can hold the personal writer lock while its storage is temporary.
residualFindings.ruling: No save corruption; current deployed 273e731 has no lock. Close the old preview and reload the current page to restore saving. Require lock-aware cross-version regression when fixing.

residualFindings.issue: GameStore.badge now returns award status instead of void, deviating from original return-shape constraint.
residualFindings.ruling: Private static app; existing callers compatible; synchronous operation, persisted schemas and reward behavior remain stable. Explicitly documented plan deviation.
